mapper.select: /* PatientReportMapper.getPatientDetail */ with cte_reports as ( select '01a01ce1-5d69-7d03-99c9-669409908df7' as sample_id , 'RTI' as panel_code , '생식기 감염 종합' as panel_name , date '2026-10-15' as test_date , 5 as positive_count , date '2026-10-15' as report_created_date , 0 as print_count , null::timestamp as last_printed_at union all select '01a01ce1-5a44-7416-943e-598621a158a2' as sample_id , 'ABI' as panel_code , '호흡기 감염 종합' as panel_name , date '2026-10-15' as test_date , 5 as positive_count , date '2026-10-15' as report_created_date , 1 as print_count , timestamp '2026-10-16 00:00:00' as last_printed_at union all select '01a01ce1-5f82-7099-bc35-0a139bc766b2' as sample_id , 'GTI' as panel_code , '소화기 감염 종합' as panel_name , date '2026-10-15' as test_date , 4 as positive_count , date '2026-10-15' as report_created_date , 0 as print_count , null::timestamp as last_printed_at ) select a.sample_id , a.panel_code , a.panel_name , a.test_date , a.positive_count , a.report_created_date , a.print_count , a.last_printed_at from cte_reports as a where a.sample_id = #{sampleId}
